external_resources: The 2026 brief allowed AI tools and unlabeled test measurements. Hidden labels must not be sought and specimen IDs must not be predictors. Verify the rules for any new assessment.
notes: Historical 2026 Smart Coatings baseline configuration. Obtain the original NPZ archives and sample submission separately, then use scripts/prepare_smart_coatings.py to create this CSV layout. Fill in your own identity before export. The bundled baseline models do not reproduce the report's custom Gaussian EM or condition-modulated quadratic model.
